configuration: Filtered polling; +/-16 g, +/-2000 deg/s; fixed deployed model and thresholds; current 60-ms timing guard. Registers restored after each phase.
method: Each phase is separately initialized: fresh gravity filter, scorer and confirmation/cooldown state. Cross-phase transition windows are not measured. Nominal phase duration includes initial filter/window startup. User readiness recorded in conversation; actual motion not independently verified or amplitude-matched.
alert_behavior: Record policy events only; no GPIO, countdown or SMS.
logging: Each phase has raw sensor data, scores, metadata, register readbacks and summary; appended to last_results.txt before next phase. C3 remains pending until all eleven phases completed.
